utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again, just so I make sure I have everything right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — please start with nails, tape, tarps, and any working tools first. If you find those, I’ll tighten up the rest of the list and keep the pickup logistics simple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess — I’ll send over the locations I have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — send them along and I’ll make sure everyone has the latest locations too. If you hear of any tape, sturdy boxes, or hand tools, those’d still be super helpful.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tool kit again. Just let me know what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’d be great. I’m checking what still needs doing for the repair drive, and I’ll let you know the first fix once I have the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Kira — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and we could really use help sorting tools and greeting folks at check-in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s Sunday at the community center, right? I can help sort tools and handle check-in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell — we’re still gathering the basics first: nails, tarps, tape, and a few working tools. If you spot any of those, send me the locations and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — send over the latest repair drive details, and I’ll spread the invite right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send the latest details now. If you can also share the most urgent need, I’ll help get that out first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s Sunday at the community center, and we still need the most help sorting tools and greeting people at check-in. If you can lend a hand, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I can help sort tools and do check-in. I’ll head over now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m putting the final details together now. I’ll send the locations, timing, and volunteer list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great — let’s keep the leaky sink and front door hinge at the top. Send the details when you can, and I’ll keep building the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send over a clear list of the locations and priorities next, so we can keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—send me the priorities first, and I’ll check our supplies for the urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — we still need a few basic tools and some sturdy supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’m still tracking the basic tools and sturdy supplies. Send me the locations when you have them, and I’ll keep the repair drive list straight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re mostly short on basic hand tools and replacement parts right now. If you can help source a few specific supplies, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What specific hand tools and replacement parts do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what’s the biggest repair need right now?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The biggest need right now is the repair details going back out clearly, and I’ll resend them so everyone has the latest info.
